scoring.notes: Common checks guard evidence fidelity and proof claims. Per-case atomic predicates cover the diagnostic and closure contracts, including negative pressure against broad repairs, premature closure, unsafe retention, unrelated cleanup, and excessive tests. Response-only answers describe actions, not execution. Static validation does not establish retained effectiveness.

coverage_notes: Response-only cases use supplied evidence and describe required future work. The packaged-client generator-failure case absorbs the former repeated missing-resource artifact failures; the runtime-probe escalation case absorbs the former retained-field-probe case; the explicit repair-commit case absorbs the former explicit closure-commit handoff while the simple-repair checkpoint-commit case keeps checkpoint-default pressure; the recurring cleanup-symptom case absorbs the former repeated-similar-finding review. The PDF export repair case grades durable-record meaning rather than field layout. The interrupted-diagnosis case separately guards environment drift; the duration-parser case guards test proliferation. The commit-gate repair case guards repair-footprint choice and an unverified install premise. Compaction has static validation only; effectiveness is Unproven until an authorized comparison. The free-text option-change case covers the smallest user-answerable question only conditionally, inside a target-set ambiguity; no dedicated case establishes exhausted evidence inspection and a user-only remaining unknown as its premises, parked for want of an observed failure.
